app_desc: Merge photos and videos from several folders, remove duplicates, and number the files in order.
merge_page_desc: Combine photos and videos from several folders into one.
run_select_output: Choose an output folder to continue.
run_add_source: Add at least one source folder to continue.
run_ready_main: Ready to add {count} folder(s) to the library.
run_ready_inside: Ready to tidy the selected folder.
mode_desc_main_folder: Use output as main folder, re-index existing files, and merge new files in
mode_note: Duplicates have the same content and extension. IMG_0072-style names sort by number; UUID-style names sort by date.
main_page_desc: Import new files into a folder and keep it sorted.
main_page_sources_hint: Import list: {count} folder(s) will be merged into the main folder.
main_page_no_sources_hint: No import folders selected. This will only organize media already in the main folder.
main_page_note: Existing files are sorted first, then imports are added, then all files are renumbered.
inside_page_desc: Sort and renumber the files already in a folder.
inside_page_note: Files are sorted and renumbered in place. Nothing is imported.
empty_no_source: Drop folders here or click Add folder
empty_no_main_source: Drop folders here to import them (optional)
prompt_prefix: Prefix for this folder (optional). Example: full, short, ref
msg_folder_exists: This folder has already been added.
msg_edit_one_at_a_time: You can edit one prefix at a time.
msg_need_input: Add at least one source folder.
error_output_same_as_input: Output folder cannot be the same as an input folder.
log_output_organized: Organized output: {count} files (images first, videos last).
msg_busy_close: A job is still running. Cancel it and close the app?
log_cancelled_safe: Cancelled. Safe mode discarded all staged changes; nothing was modified.
log_cancelled_partial: Cancelled. Changes already applied were kept (safe mode was off).
error_output_inside_input: Output folder cannot be inside an input folder.
app_tagline: Merge, sort and clean up photos and videos.
nav_desc_main: Import into a folder and keep it sorted
nav_desc_inside: Sort and renumber files in place
run_ready_main_none: Ready to sort the files already in the library.
opt_clear_output_hint: Deletes existing photos and videos in the output folder.
opt_allow_duplicates_hint: Import files even if the same content already exists.
opt_safe_temp_workspace_hint: Works on a temporary copy and applies changes only when finished.
opt_remove_duplicates_hint: Deletes files with identical content inside the folder.
confirm_delete_sources: Original files will be deleted from the source folders after they are copied.
confirm_clear_output: Existing photos and videos in the output folder will be deleted first.
confirm_remove_duplicates: Duplicate files in this folder will be deleted.
